name: VersaCarte
seoDescription: Gerard is an electrical and telecommunications engineer who designs and builds mobile apps, web platforms, IoT systems and cloud backends. This is his personal reference site and CV.
specialization: Electrical and telecommunications engineering, with software I design and ship myself — apps, platforms and connected systems.
degree: BEng Electrical and Telecommunications Engineering — Moi University, Second Class Honours (2020–2025)

about.label: About
about.title: Engineer by training. Builder by practice.
about.body: I am Gerard, an electrical and telecommunications engineer. VersaCarte is my personal practice — the name I ship under — not a company that makes the work for me. I design, build and document the projects you see here.
about.mission: I work across power, telecoms, firmware and full-stack software so a system can be understood from the sensor or circuit through to the interface people use.
values: I own the work from schematic, firmware or API through to the product people touch
I document architecture so others can audit, extend and hand it on
I design for real conditions: variable power, connectivity, devices and payments
about.imageAlt: Engineering workspace with electronics and a laptop

hero.title: Gerard is solving problems through electrical engineering, telecoms and software he builds himself
hero.subtitle: As an electrical and telecommunications engineer with a strong focus on mobile apps, web platforms and connected systems, he designs end-to-end work you can put on a CV and stand behind.
hero.imageAlt: Engineering workspace used as a portrait stand-in until a personal photo is added

vision.label: About
vision.title: Engineer by training. Builder by practice.
vision.body: I am Gerard. The projects on this site are work I created — Resphinx, VersaRent, FileSendNX, Smart Traffic Control and related systems — not studio output from a company team.

services.label: What I do
services.title: Engineering and software I take from brief to working system

items.title: Electrical & telecoms
items.body: Protection thinking, field documentation, networking and systems that have to hold up outside a lab.

items.title: Apps & web platforms
items.body: React Native, Expo, Astro and React products I design and ship with clear architecture.

items.title: IoT & cloud
items.body: Firmware, telemetry and backends that connect hardware to software people can actually use.

why.label: How I work
why.title: One person from schematic to shipped interface
why.body: You work with me directly. Hardware, firmware, APIs and mobile or web UI stay in one thread instead of three vendors handing off blame.
why.imageAlt: Laptop and monitors during a build

process.label: How it works
process.title: A simple path from first conversation to something you can use

steps.title: Start a conversation
steps.body: We talk about the problem, constraints and whether I am the right engineer for it.

steps.title: Brief
steps.body: Scope, timeline and deliverables written down so the work stays honest.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: I design, implement and refine with feedback — firmware, software or both.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Working system, source, and notes your team can pick up without me in the room.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: A short window after handoff for questions and small corrections.

work.label: Featured works
work.title: Projects I created
work.body: Selected systems I designed and built. Use them as proof of work on a CV, not as a company brochure.
